amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_energy; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

product.name: Water, tap
product.description: Meter purchased tap water actually used for brush/tool cleaning or supplier-authorized paint dilution; do not count water already inside purchased wet paint again. Record temperature and measured density when converting volume to mass; no generic density default.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_water; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

product.name: Polyethylene film
product.description: Polyethylene shipment wrapping film only where actually used; weigh net film and identify grade/recycled content. Generic film identity does not establish a packaging recipe. Film retained as transport packaging is outside reference panel mass.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_pack; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

product.name: Polypropylene packaging strap

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_pack; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

product.role: Pallets, box pallets and other load boards, of wood, pallet collars of wood
product.name: Pallets, box pallets and other load boards, of wood, pallet collars of wood
product.description: Actual supplied wooden load-board pallet within the broader identity; specify construction and measured net mass. Track retained/reused pallets and charge only evidenced attributable production/repair burden; no default pallet reuse count and no collar input when absent.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_pack; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

product.name: Lubricating oil
product.description: Petroleum-derived liquid lubricating oil added to machining/handling equipment during the surveyed production period, only if present. Reconcile stocks and retained equipment charge; no synthetic oil, grease or release-agent proxy.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_maintenance; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

product.name: freight transport
product.description: Actual road-freight service for incoming coated board and auxiliaries, and external waste legs only where not included in the chosen treatment provider. Record each shipment leg, wet transported mass, distance, carrier/vehicle/load/backhaul and provider inclusions. No default distance, payload, return fraction or fuel. Do not repeat delivered-material or waste-provider transport; outbound delivery to a construction site is excluded from factory-gate reference. Other transport modes require distinct verified service rows.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_transport; retain raw leg totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

product.role: Shuttering for concrete constructional work made out of wood
product.name: Shuttering for concrete constructional work made out of wood
product.description: Exactly one shipment-accepted, cut-to-drawing unframed birch formwork facing panel reference. Net panel includes wood, cured PF bond, retained face film, new cured edge paint and retained water; excludes transport packaging, support frame and installation fasteners. Same panel moving between machining, sealing and packing is not another product output.

amount.expression: 1 kg

waste.name: Phenolic-film-coated PF-bonded birch plywood offcut
waste.description: Unagglomerated coated/bonded offcuts and rejected pieces sent to external treatment. Retain resin/film/water content and destination. Agglomerated wood briquettes and untreated sawdust are incompatible; internal rework stays an internal loop.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_waste; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

waste.role: Captured PF-bonded phenolic-film plywood machining dust
waste.name: Captured PF-bonded phenolic-film plywood machining dust
waste.description: Captured sawing/drilling dust containing wood, cured bond and film. Weigh container tare/net mass, record moisture/composition and external receiver; do not treat captured dust as air emission or clean biomass fuel.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_waste; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

waste.name: Waste paint, water-based
waste.description: Separately collected waterborne acrylic paint residue at generation, with solids/water state and actual treatment. Do not include separately weighed washwater or container polymer in this row.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_waste; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

waste.role: Acrylic edge-paint brush-cleaning wastewater to external treatment
waste.name: Acrylic edge-paint brush-cleaning wastewater to external treatment
waste.description: Separately collected acrylic-paint brush/tool washwater; measure wet mass and suspended/dissolved constituents and receiver. No direct discharge covered. Mining, manganese-slag washing or already-treated wastewater identities are incompatible.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_water; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

waste.role: Empty HDPE edge-paint container with residual acrylic paint
waste.name: Empty HDPE edge-paint container with residual acrylic paint
waste.description: If the actual paint arrives in HDPE containers, record net empty container polymer and adherent residue separately, without counting residue twice in waste_paint. Other container materials require separate atomic rows and verified identities.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_waste; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

waste.name: Discarded unwashed polyethylene packaging film
waste.description: Actual discarded incoming/packing-trim PE film at generation, excluding film leaving with shipment. Cleaned mechanical-recycling output and PET scrap are incompatible; track contaminant state and treatment.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_waste; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

waste.name: Used lubricating oil
waste.description: Actual removed petroleum-based lubricating oil from equipment maintenance; track contamination and external treatment, retained charge and stocks. Generated waste identity does not imply recycling credit or a treatment process.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_maintenance; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

elementary.name: particles (PM2.5)
elementary.description: Outdoor-air unspecified PM2.5 mass at actual exhaust/fugitive release, after control. No correction flow or indoor exposure concentration. Use the finest measured bin only once.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_air; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

elementary.name: particles (PM2.5 - PM10)
elementary.description: Outdoor-air unspecified particles in the disjoint PM2.5–PM10 bin; same outlet/time/method as nested totals. No simultaneous extra full PM10 exchange.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_air; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

elementary.name: particles (> PM10)
elementary.description: Outdoor-air unspecified particles >PM10 from the same measured distribution. Do not equate unspecified particle size with this bin; no extra total-PM exchange.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_air; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

elementary.name: water vapour
elementary.description: Water actually evaporated from paint, cleaned tools or changed board moisture and released outdoors; derive a closed water balance after separating non-water volatile loss. Ambient humidity is not a purchased process-water input; retain actual inlet/outlet humidity and any measured net moisture uptake/release in the physical water ledger. No steam energy exchange is implied.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_water; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

elementary.name: formaldehyde
elementary.description: Actual formaldehyde, CAS 50-00-0, released outdoors during machining/storage/drying only if demonstrated by site screening or measurements. Cured-panel chamber ppm, hot-press factors and total VOC cannot substitute for factory emitted kg.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_air; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

elementary.name: 2-n-butoxy-1-ethanol
elementary.description: Outdoor-air unspecified 2-butoxyethanol, CAS 111-76-2, only if the actual waterborne paint/SDS and site balance identify it. No default positive emission or assumption that all acrylic paints contain it. Retained, waste and airborne fractions are measured separately.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_air; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

elementary.name: carbon dioxide (biogenic)
elementary.description: Biogenic carbon dioxide to outdoor-air unspecified only if actual on-site wood-carbon oxidation during storage is evidenced; no combustion in the declared route. Record demonstrated absence separately from unmeasured amounts. Do not delete actual biogenic CO2 from LCI because of an LCIA or GHG reporting convention; fossil resin/coating carbon is separate.

amount.expression: Collect amount per 1 kg reference flow using cp_carbon; retain raw totals and the same accepted net-mass denominator.

product.name: Untreated coniferous machining sawdust sold as co-product

product.name: Untreated coniferous planer shavings sold as co-product

amount.expression: Same-cohort unallocated total in this exchange unit divided by Q accepted net solid m3; per 1 m3 reference flow. Retain raw stage totals and stock changes; apply no burden-allocation share to this physical amount.

waste.role: Discarded untreated solid coniferous timber offcuts

The broad Offcut identity has concordant woodworking-remnant names and description with no specified treatment route; its source classification as agglomerated waste is contradictory and remains subject to clarification. Do not treat all database metadata as verified. Require actual wood species/state, absence of adhesive or coating, contamination, moisture, receiver and provider/background compatibility before linkage; incompatible physical material or treatment requires another identity. Landfill or an incompatible treatment route requires another compatible waste identity. Weigh captured material once in Mass/kg; keep saleable residues, recycled internal material and emitted particulate separate. Captured dust is not an elementary emission, and external combustion is not onsite combustion in this dry mechanical route.

required_qualifiers: Species and source for each wood layer
thickness of each layer and total
supplied solids/water and evidenced cure extent
clear UV coating SKU and chemistry per stage
measured cover dimensions and joining profile

product.name: Veneer sheets and sheets for plywood and other wood sawn lengthwise, sliced or peeled, of a thickness not exceeding 6 mm, of other non-coniferous wood
product.description: This is a separate face veneer exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Weigh the separate purchased dry face/wear veneer of one identified non-tropical hardwood species and supplier; record layer thickness, moisture and rejects. Split another species or supply route into a separate atomic row. No pooled wood input.

product.name: Veneer sheets and sheets for plywood and other wood sawn lengthwise, sliced or peeled, of a thickness not exceeding 6 mm, of other non-coniferous wood
product.description: This is a separate core veneer exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Weigh the separate purchased dry cross-grain core veneer of one identified non-tropical hardwood species and supplier; record layer thickness, moisture and rejects. Split another species or supply route into a separate atomic row. No pooled wood input.

product.name: Veneer sheets and sheets for plywood and other wood sawn lengthwise, sliced or peeled, of a thickness not exceeding 6 mm, of other non-coniferous wood
product.description: This is a separate back veneer exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Weigh the separate purchased dry balancing backing veneer of one identified non-tropical hardwood species and supplier; record layer thickness, moisture and rejects. Split another species or supply route into a separate atomic row. No pooled wood input.

product.name: Urea-formaldehyde resin
product.description: This is a separate uf glue exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Use this generic UF-resin row only for a real independently supplied resin state and mass reference supported by its native identity and actual provider; record supplied resin mass, measured solids/moisture and actual onsite mixing/application. A bought complete prepared aqueous or compounded UF adhesive requires one specific compatible complete-formulation supply row and provider retaining supplier resin manufacture, formulation preparation and delivery before use; the generic resin UUID alone does not establish that complete supply. Its included resin, catalyst, carrier water and additives are analytical composition, not new external purchases. Actual independently purchased additions and onsite dilution/mixing water, utilities and losses remain separate. Preserve supplier wet/active reference correspondence; never equate whole wet preparation kg to dry-resin kg or count included water twice. No default solids fraction. Retain actual supplied precondensation state, recipe and cure-extent evidence under cp_recipe; supplied solids do not automatically equal cured retained resin mass.

product.name: Ammonium Chloride
product.description: This is a separate glue hardener exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Only when ammonium chloride is separately dosed: weigh pure salt, record concentration/purity and mixing losses; embedded catalyst in purchased adhesive is not a duplicate input. Absent dosing requires evidence of absence.

product.name: Tap water
product.description: This is a separate process water exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Meter separately added treated tap water for glue dilution or cleaning, convert volume using measured water density at temperature, and separate internal recirculation; exclude resin-contained water from this input.

product.name: Alternating current
product.description: This is a separate electricity exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Sum attributable metered kWh for conditioning, glue spreading, pressing, sawing, sanding, profiling, UV lamps, extraction, electric handling and packing; convert to MJ with 1 kWh = 3.6 MJ. Use only a verified 1-35 kV user-side supply and separate measured transformer losses; no duplicate stage totals.

product.name: Process heat from steam
product.description: This is a separate press heat exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: For supplied industrial-boiler steam heat, record supplier reference definition plus delivered steam mass, pressure, temperature, dryness and condensate return; calculate heat from measured enthalpies only on the supplier-defined basis. Gross calorific value/MJ identity does not prove net delivered heat; keep the background link pending when the reference basis is unknown. Do not record both steam heat and its upstream boiler fuel as external inputs.

product.name: UV-curable wood-flooring primer
product.description: This is a separate primer exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Weigh one purchased formulation/SKU issued to this coating stage less measured returns; retain SDS, solids, resin chemistry, reactive diluent, photoinitiator and water/solvent fractions. Record separately from other coating stages. Filler is conditional on actual use; clear uncoloured route has no stain input. Do not invent a default formulation or curing conversion.

product.name: UV-curable wood-flooring sealer
product.description: This is a separate sealer exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Weigh one purchased formulation/SKU issued to this coating stage less measured returns; retain SDS, solids, resin chemistry, reactive diluent, photoinitiator and water/solvent fractions. Record separately from other coating stages. Filler is conditional on actual use; clear uncoloured route has no stain input. Do not invent a default formulation or curing conversion.

product.name: UV-curable wood-flooring clear topcoat
product.description: This is a separate topcoat exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Weigh one purchased formulation/SKU issued to this coating stage less measured returns; retain SDS, solids, resin chemistry, reactive diluent, photoinitiator and water/solvent fractions. Record separately from other coating stages. Filler is conditional on actual use; clear uncoloured route has no stain input. Do not invent a default formulation or curing conversion.

product.name: UV-curable wood-flooring pore filler
product.description: This is a separate filler exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Weigh one purchased formulation/SKU issued to this coating stage less measured returns; retain SDS, solids, resin chemistry, reactive diluent, photoinitiator and water/solvent fractions. Record separately from other coating stages. Filler is conditional on actual use; clear uncoloured route has no stain input. Do not invent a default formulation or curing conversion.

product.name: Aluminum oxide (alumina)
product.description: This is a separate alumina exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Only separately dosed primary-produced aluminium oxide: weigh addition and document particle grade, purity and supplier route; embedded alumina in purchased topcoat is not counted twice. Background grade compatibility must be demonstrated.

product.name: Acetone for coating-roller cleaning
product.description: This is a separate cleaner exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Only when SDS identifies acetone cleaning: weigh new solvent, purity, recovered quantity and losses. Another actual cleaning chemical requires its own row; no generic solvent total substitutes.

product.name: corrugated board boxes
product.description: This is a separate carton exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Weigh new corrugated boxes issued to this product lot; record board grade and fibre sourcing, separate damaged scrap and material leaving with product. Packaging is outside accepted flooring net mass.

product.name: Polyethylene film
product.description: This is a separate film exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Only if PE film is actually used: weigh film roll issue minus returns, record polymer grade and losses. Verify actual polyethylene-film material state and supplier/provider compatibility before background linkage; the polymer identity does not establish a matched packaging dataset. No assumption that every carton is film wrapped.

product.name: Inbound diesel road-freight service
product.description: This is a separate freight exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: For transport absent from supplied product datasets, use measured shipment mass and actual loaded distance, vehicle class, fuel, load factor and backhaul; keep one mode per row and avoid double counting delivered datasets. Select a supplier dataset with matching tonne-kilometre definition.

product.name: Assembled flooring panels made out of wood
product.description: 1 kg accepted factory-prefinished flooring net mass at declared delivery moisture, including retained UF and coatings, excluding all transport packaging; reconcile effective installed-joint coverage, thickness and species-layer records for the same lot.

amount.expression: 1 kg

waste.name: Offcut
waste.description: This is a separate wood trim exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Weigh separately collected actual non-agglomerated solid UF-bonded panel offcuts and rejected panels; document wood/adhesive state, moisture, coating contamination, destination and waste status. Confirm that physical state and recipient/provider acceptance before treatment linkage; a broad offcut identity does not establish matching treatment. Unglued veneer rejects are a different stream and must be split when present. Retain physical output mass before environmental allocation.

waste.name: UF-bonded wood sanding dust
waste.description: This is a separate bonded dust exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Weigh captured UF-bonded sanding dust separately from escaped airborne particles and solid offcuts; identify coating fraction and waste treatment. Dust from untreated veneer before gluing requires its own row.

waste.name: Spent UF adhesive residue
waste.description: This is a separate glue waste exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Weigh waste UF glue separately, including water and solids; distinguish internal reusable returns from external disposal; no mixture with varnish residue.

waste.name: Waste paint
waste.description: This is a separate coating waste exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Weigh UV coating residue for one formulation and waste state separately from glue and solvent wastes; identify uncured monomers, contamination and external treatment. Split physically different residues.

waste.name: Untreated UF-glue cleaning wastewater
waste.description: This is a separate wastewater exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Measure untreated aqueous UF-glue cleaning wastewater crossing to treatment; record water mass, suspended solids, dissolved formaldehyde and actual destination. Coating cleaning wastewater is separate when present. Do not call treated effluent this untreated input; internal recirculation is not external discharge.

waste.name: Spent acetone cleaning solvent
waste.description: This is a separate spent acetone exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Only for actual acetone cleaning: weigh spent liquid sent outside, measure water/coating contamination and recovered acetone. Reconcile with new solvent input and acetone to air; never assume all input evaporates.

waste.name: Packaging waste, cardboard
waste.description: This is a separate carton scrap exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Weigh actual corrugated packaging trim and damaged boxes sent out separately; the identity record estimate is not a default scrap fraction.

elementary.name: formaldehyde
elementary.description: This is a separate formaldehyde exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Measure formaldehyde (CAS 50-00-0) mass discharged after controls from pressing, curing and handling during manufacture; retain source-specific concentration, gas volume and operating hours. Product-use chamber tests do not quantify manufacturing discharge. Compartment: outdoor air, unspecified; do not assume urban, rural, stack height or long-term release. Record presence/absence from site evidence, not from the identity lookup.

elementary.name: acetone
elementary.description: This is a separate acetone air exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Only actual acetone cleaning: measure or close a solvent balance for acetone (CAS 67-64-1) released to outdoor air; subtract retained, recovered and disposed acetone; no generic VOC total used as acetone. Compartment: outdoor air, unspecified; do not assume urban, rural, stack height or long-term release. Record presence/absence from site evidence, not from the identity lookup.

elementary.name: particles (PM2.5)
elementary.description: This is a separate pm25 exchange at the flooring-unit boundary; collect it under the stated route and measurement conditions.

amount.expression: Measure discharged particles <=2.5 micrometres after dust controls. This is an exclusive bin; captured dust is a waste output, not an air emission. Compartment: outdoor air, unspecified; do not assume urban, rural, stack height or long-term release. Record presence/absence from site evidence, not from the identity lookup.
